mapper.select: SELECT point_history_id, member_id, order_id, history_type, point_amount, balance_after, description, created_at FROM POINT_HISTORY WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, point_history_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO POINT_HISTORY ( member_id, order_id, history_type, point_amount, balance_after, description, created_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{orderId}, #{historyType}, #{pointAmount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{description}, NOW() )
